name: celia-video
description: Celia.ai launch film, built as code with Remotion.

scripts.audio:setup: python3 -m venv .audio-venv && .audio-venv/bin/pip install -q kokoro-onnx soundfile scipy && mkdir -p .audio-models && curl -sSL -o .audio-models/kokoro-v1.0.onnx https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.0/kokoro-v1.0.onnx && curl -sSL -o .audio-models/voices-v1.0.bin https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.0/voices-v1.0.bin
scripts.render:hero: remotion render Hero16x9 out/demo-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k && node scripts/loudnorm.mjs out/demo-raw.mp4 ../site/media/demo.mp4
scripts.render:poster: remotion still Hero16x9 out/demo-poster.png --frame=960 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/demo-poster.png -q:v 3 ../site/media/demo-poster.jpg
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render Vertical9x16 out/vertical-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k && node scripts/loudnorm.mjs out/vertical-raw.mp4 out/celia-vertical.mp4
scripts.render: npm run typecheck && npm run render:hero && npm run render:poster && npm run render:vertical
scripts.contact: node scripts/stills.mjs Hero16x9 && node scripts/stills.mjs Vertical9x16
